input.quote: 22.14 Solicitation. Neither party shall solicit the employees of the other party during the Term of this Agreement, for any reason.
input.rationale: § 22.14 is the only solicitation covenant in the Agreement (no no-hire, "employ or engage" or "induce to leave" language appears anywhere). It is mutual and bars only solicitation, so the mutuality and no-hire elements of the fallback are already satisfied. However it fails the fallback on three material terms: scope covers all employees of the other party rather than only personnel directly involved in the Services (walk-away territory), duration runs for the entire multi-year Term rather than 12 months after involvement ends, and there is no carve-out for general advertisements or unsolicited approaches. We therefore narrowed scope and duration and added the carve-out sentence, landing the clause at the fallback with minimal edits rather than deleting it to the preferred position.

mappings.quote: Neither party shall solicit the employees of the other party

mappings.element: The restriction covers only personnel directly involved in the Services.
The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months after the person's involvement ends.
General advertisements are excluded from the restriction.
Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the restriction.
The restriction does not prohibit hiring.
mappings.quote: Neither party shall solicit the employees of the other party

proposal.summary: Narrow § 22.14 non-solicit to personnel directly involved in the Services for 12 months after involvement ends, and add general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have narrowed the mutual non-solicit in § 22.14 to employees directly involved in performing the Services and limited it to twelve months after that involvement ends, and added carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches. That is our fallback position; as drafted the clause reaches all employees of either party for the whole Term with no carve-outs.

ops.oldText: Neither party shall solicit the employees of the other party during the Term of this Agreement, for any reason.
ops.newText: Neither party shall solicit the employees of the other party who are directly involved in performing the Services, during their involvement and for twelve (12) months thereafter.

ops.text: The foregoing restriction does not apply to general advertisements or to unsolicited approaches by an employee.
